title: Regularized Unbalanced Optimal Transport with Pearson Marginal Penalties
abstract: arXiv:2503.15105v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study quadratically regularized unbalanced optimal transport with Pearson marginal penalties and a lower bound $\delta\ge0$ on the plan, including the sparse case $\delta=0$. We organize the analysis around the active interface, where the plan switches from its lower bound to larger values. We prove a Newton remainder estimate that depends linearly on the marginal measure of the boundary layer around this interface, and a maximum-norm inverse estimate uniform over all Newton derivatives and cell volumes. Together they give local superlinear convergence of semismooth Newton iteration in function space, of q-order at least $1+\alpha$ when the boundary-layer measure is $O(t^\alpha)$, and a common convergence neighborhood along each refinement sequence whose data converge uniformly. translated_title: 具有Pearson边际惩罚的正则化非平衡最优传输
translated_abstract: 我们研究了带有Pearson边际惩罚的二次正则化非平衡最优传输问题，并对传输计划施加下界 δ≥0，其中包括稀疏情形 δ=0。我们围绕活跃界面来组织分析，即传输计划从其下界切换到更大值的位置。我们证明了一个牛顿余项估计，其线性依赖于该界面周围边界层的边际测度，以及一个对所有牛顿导数和单元体积均一致的最大范数逆估计。两者结合，给出了函数空间中半光滑牛顿迭代的局部超线性收敛：当边界层测度为 O(t^α) 时，q-阶收敛率至少为 1+α，并且在数据一致收敛的每个加密序列上具有共同的收敛邻域。对于横向界面，离散势相对于连续势的单元平均具有二阶超逼近性。（原摘要末尾“一个方向性……”处被截断，故此处不完整。）
tldr: 该论文针对带Pearson边际惩罚的二次正则化非平衡最优传输问题（含稀疏下界 δ=0 情形），通过活跃界面处的牛顿余项估计与一致最大范数逆估计，证明了函数空间中半光滑牛顿迭代的局部超线性收敛（q阶至少为 1+α）以及离散势的二阶超逼近性。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes local superlinear convergence (q-order at least 1+α) of semismooth Newton iteration in function space for quadratically regularized unbalanced optimal transport with Pearson marginal penalties and a plan lower bound (including the sparse δ=0 case), via a Newton remainder estimate tied to the boundary-layer marginal measure, a uniform maximum-norm inverse estimate, and second-order supercloseness of discrete potentials at transverse interfaces.
